info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Access Entitlement API
info.description: The Customer Access Entitlement API provides a means for businesses to retrieve the access entitlements associated with a specific customer. By utilizing this API, developers can seamlessly integrate customer entitlement management into their banking applications, ensuring that users can obtain the necessary information about access rights. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and backend systems that require entitlement details to optimize customer interactions and service delivery. The API enhances operational efficiency by facilitating quick and accurate retrieval of entitlement data.

get.description: Fetches the access entitlement information for a specified customer identified by their unique identifier. This operation allows you to view the entitlements available to the customer, which can assist in managing access rights and permissions effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the access entitlement details for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. It provides the necessary parameters and structure to ensure accurate and efficient data retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the customer access entitlement details.

GetCustomerAccessEntitlementCUST100045Re.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving customer access entitlement details.

GetCustomerAccessEntitlementCUST100045Re.title: Customer Access Entitlement Response

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the customer.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the access entitlement becomes effective.

version.description: Version number of the entitlement record.
